title: Business & Digital Banking Graduate Programmes 2027
description: PTSB is one of Ireland's leading retail and SME banks, with an innovative range of products and services powered through an evolving digital landscape, our focus is centred on ensuring we deliver what our customers, colleagues and communities need to be successful. The PTSB Business & Digital Banking Graduate Programmes are a 24-month development programme offering graduates the opportunity to build their career through one of three specialist streams: Agricultural Banking, Asset Finance or Digital Channels. Through structured rotations, hands-on experience and exposure to key areas of the business, graduates will develop expertise in customer relationship management, lending and credit, commercial decision-making, digital innovation and business growth. Supported by experienced colleagues, assigned buddies and a comprehensive learning and development framework, graduates will gain the skills, experience and professional networks needed to build a successful long-term career at PTSB. **Agricultural Retail Banking Graduate Programme** Support Ireland's farming and agribusiness communities through exposure to business banking, commercial lending, credit analysis and relationship management. **Asset Finance Retail Banking Graduate Programme** Develop expertise in Asset finance solutions, customer acquisition, fulfilment, customer service and commercial growth across the full asset finance lifecycle. **Digital Channels Retail Banking Graduate Programme** Help shape the future of digital banking by enhancing customer journeys, delivering digital innovation and supporting technology-enabled change. Full details of each graduate stream, including rotations, responsibilities and requirements, are available within the individual role profiles. **Responsibilities:** As a Graduate in PTSB you can expect to perform some of the following activities: * Gain exposure and contribute to business-critical projects in a fast-paced environment, build strong management, interpersonal and technical skills throughout the Programme. * Adopt a continuous improvement mindset to identify customer pain points and process enhancements. * Due to the changing nature of work and rotations, we encourage flexibility amongst graduates to perform other ad hoc activities and seize new opportunities as they arise. * Establish and maintain professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders. * Engage with all areas of the organisation supporting colleagues and Bank wide initiatives. **Requirements:** * Graduating in 2027/ Graduated in 2026 * You must be legally entitled to work in the Republic of Ireland without restriction\*\*\* for the duration of the programme (September 2027 - September 2029) * \*\*\*Without restriction refers to candidates who have a valid visa in place and do not require any sponsorship (from company or self-sponsorship) of work visa from September 2027 - September 2029. * Candidates must have or be on track to achieve a minimum result of a 2:1 Second Class Honours, Grade 1 (60 - 69%) in their Level 8 qualification or above **This is a 24-month fixed term contract based in St. Stephen's Green (Hybrid Options available within Republic of Ireland only)** **Is this you?** Please apply online on our website or via the apply link of this role. Your application will be sent through to our Talent Acquisition team and they will be in touch regarding your application. We reserve the right to draw up a shortlist for interview. The Bank understands the importance of a consistent and relentless focus on championing diversity and inclusion. We aim to attract, recruit, and retain individuals with diverse backgrounds, skills, competencies and abilities to work collaboratively to enhance the service we provide to all of our customers and the communities we serve.

title: GROWTH MARKETER – EARLY-STAGE TECH STARTUP
description: **GROWTH MARKETER – EARLY-STAGE TECH STARTUPStart lean. Prove what works. Grow with us.** **Dublin | Part-Time | Flexible / Hybrid | €80/week + Performance Bonus & Growth Opportunity** We are an **early-stage Irish technology startup** looking for an ambitious, commercially minded **Growth Marketer** to help us build our customer base from the ground up. This is not a traditional marketing role. We are looking for someone who wants to **test ideas, find what works, measure real results and help turn an early-stage business into a growing company.** You will work directly with the founders, have real influence from the beginning and help shape how we acquire and grow our customer base. THE OPPORTUNITY The role starts part-time at: **€80 per week + performance-based bonus** We want to be completely transparent: we are an early-stage startup, so the role starts small. But we are **not looking for someone we want to keep at €80 per week forever.** If you demonstrate that your work is helping us acquire customers, improve conversions and build sustainable growth, we want your **responsibility, remuneration and career opportunity to grow with the business.** Our approach is simple: **Start lean → Prove your impact → Take on more responsibility → Grow with us.** Future progression will depend on measurable performance, business growth, revenue, cash flow, increased responsibilities and mutual agreement. It is not automatic or guaranteed. **If you help us grow, we want you to have the opportunity to grow with us.**WHAT YOU WILL DO You will help us build, test and continuously improve our growth strategy, including: * Customer acquisition & lead generation * Meta Ads & Google Ads / PPC * SEO & content * Social media growth * Landing-page & conversion optimisation * Email marketing & CRM * Partnerships, referrals & community growth * A/B testing and growth experiments * Analytics, KPIs & performance reporting We don't want marketing activity just for the sake of being busy. **We want to know: What worked? What didn't? What did it cost? What converted? What should we do next?**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE We care about **real business growth — not vanity metrics.** We will focus on measurable results such as: **New customers** Qualified leads **Acquisition cost** Conversion **Customer activation** Campaign performance **Repeat engagement** Sustainable customer growth YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS Your first month will focus on: * Understanding the business, market and target audience * Reviewing our current marketing position * Establishing tracking and key KPIs * Identifying the strongest acquisition opportunities * Running small, controlled experiments * Testing channels, messaging and offers * Analysing results and recommending what we should do next We don't expect miracles in 30 days. **We expect ownership, experimentation, learning and measurable progress.**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Your current title matters less to us than **what you can actually do**. You may be a Growth Marketer, Performance Marketer, Digital Marketer, Paid Acquisition Specialist, Marketing Executive, ambitious marketing graduate or freelancer. Experience in some of these areas would be valuable: **Meta Ads** Google Ads **PPC** SEO **GA4** Customer Acquisition **Lead Generation** Conversion Optimisation **A/B Testing** CRM **Email Marketing** Content **Partnerships** Startup Growth You should be: * Commercially minded * Analytical and creative * Proactive and curious * Comfortable working independently * Willing to test ideas and learn quickly * Focused on measurable results * Comfortable being accountable for performance **We are looking for someone who doesn't simply say:** “I ran the campaign.” **We want someone who asks:** “Did it work? Why? What did we learn? And how can we make it better?”WORKING ARRANGEMENT This is initially a **small part-time role**, primarily remote and flexible, with regular communication with the founders and occasional in-person meetings in Dublin. We care more about **impact, progress and measurable output than hours spent at a desk.** **WHY JOIN EARLY?** You won't be joining a mature marketing department with an established playbook. **You will have the opportunity to help build the playbook.** You will work directly with the founders, have meaningful responsibility from the beginning and have the opportunity to grow your role as the company develops. **Start at €80/week + performance bonus.Prove what works.Help us build the customer base.Grow your responsibility and earning potential as the company grows.** If you're ambitious, commercially minded and excited by the challenge of building something from an early stage, **we'd love to hear from you.** **HOW TO APPLY** Please send your **CV and a short introduction** to: **info@edentherapyclinic.ie** In your application, tell us about **one campaign, project or idea where you achieved a measurable result.** Expected hours: 25.0 per week Benefits: * On-site parking Work Location: In person

description: **Background:** Veolia is Ireland’s leading environmental services company. (PMO) * Carry out Periodic reviews of EWI/SOP to ensure documents are always current and valid. * Complete Data Build on new equipment (create maintenance plans, preparing BOM, SOP’s, * Trouble-shooting and investigation of utility plant equipment faults and failures along with the Shift Operation Group. * Identifying, liaising with, and, where appropriate, co-ordination of third party contractors and suppliers on site. * Liaising with the site projects team as clients engineering representative. * Liaising with site contract team to identify suppliers and quantities of spare parts; review and updating of spare part inventory of spares in clients site store. * Ensuring Engineering areas, in liaison with Contract Manager and Contract co-ordinator, facilities and equipment are kept in a clean, safe and serviceable condition, and general housekeeping highest standards are maintained. * Continuous improvement of contract delivery on site **Requirements for the role;** * Senior Trades, City & Guilds or equivalent in Mechanical / Building Services engineering. * Engineering degree/diploma or equivalent, preferably mechanical/environmental, with two to three years post graduate experience, preferably in mechanical/building services, or * Marine qualification, with 2 to 4 years experience at sea. ***Essential*** * Experience in the pharmaceutical, Biotech or food industry * Mechanical / Building Services / Utilities experience, 3 years minimum and good understanding of the basic fundamentals of the various utilities systems. * Pumps, HVAC Systems, Air Compressors, Boilers, Plant steam systems and ancillary services, (DHW /DCW /LPHW skids), Chillers, Cooling Towers, Clean steam Boilers, Purified Water Systems, WFI Water Systems, CIP systems, Refrigeration Systems, Process gases * Building Management Systems (Scada) * Good understanding of Preventive Maintenance / Corrective Maintenance Systems. * Familiarity with Predictive Maintenance (CBM) techniques and their benefits. * Worked within a Computerized Maintenance Management (CMMS) Work Order system environment. title: Science & Engineering Rotational Graduate Programme 2027
description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. **Science & Engineering Rotational Graduate Programme 2027** **At Bristol Myers Squibb, we are inspired by a single vision transforming patients’ lives through science.** Bristol Myers Squibb is a leading global biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with serious diseases. We combine the agility of a biotechnology company with the reach and resources of an established pharmaceutical organisation. Located in Dublin, the Cruiserath Biologics Campus is a key part of the Bristol Myers Squibb global manufacturing network. The campus includes an established multi-product biologics drug substance manufacturing operation, global biologics testing capabilities and a major expansion through the new Sterile Drug Product (SDP) facility. The SDP investment will add sterile drug product manufacturing and laboratory capabilities, supporting existing medicines and future pipeline assets. Its scope includes product formulation, component preparation, aseptic filling and capping of liquid and freeze-dried vials, aseptic syringe filling, visual inspection, clean utilities and the supporting quality, engineering, digital, supply chain and operational-readiness systems. **Our rotational graduate offering is a major step towards a career that you will find fulfilling, both professionally and personally.** The programme is structured around three nine-month rotations across relevant Science, Engineering and business functions. Rotations are matched with graduate development goals and business needs, providing broad experience across the Cruiserath Campus and opportunities to contribute to both established biologics operations and the delivery, start-up and ongoing operation of the new SDP facility. As a Science or Engineering Graduate, you will work with experienced technical teams, senior management and business leaders. Depending on your rotations, you may support cross-functional activities in areas such as Manufacturing, Manufacturing Science and Technology, Quality, Engineering, Commissioning, Qualification and Validation, Computer Systems Validation, Automation, Supply Chain, Operational Excellence and Project Management. You will contribute to meaningful projects, develop an understanding of the regulated biopharmaceutical environment and build the technical, digital and interpersonal capabilities required for a long-term career at Bristol Myers Squibb. title: Trainee Solicitor
description: **The Role** Since 2015 we have been hiring trainee solicitors in our Dublin office and they are an integral part of the firm as we continue to grow. Trainees gain experience in at least three of our practice areas, and during the 24-month training programme, you will work with lawyers who are experts in their field. You will be part of the team and will work alongside the partners in delivering first class legal advice to clients. Whether you are representing a client in buying or leasing an aircraft, advising a bank (we act for 85 of the top 100 banks in the world), or attending a board meeting for an investment fund, you will be involved at every stage of the process. In the world of finance, transactions move at speed and we deal with different time zones and other lawyers and clients across the globe. It isn’t for everyone, but if it is for you, you won’t learn your craft better anywhere else. **What You'll Do** Trainees work closely with our lawyers on a wide range of matters and clients. Your role will involve a range of responsibilities. There will be constant learning and development and opportunities to undertake secondments with clients. You will be guided throughout your traineeship and provided with feedback and support to aid your development. You will have the opportunity to work with international clients and challenging work and will see increased responsibility as you progress combined with appropriate support and resources. **Who We Are Looking For** We are seeking candidates who have an interest in learning more about financial services law in particular. We look for candidates with a strong educational record who are: * Ambitious, entrepreneurial, determined and invested in the long-term development of themselves and the success of our firm * Commercially aware of the financial services sector * Good communicators, problem solvers and team players * Self-motivated * Energetic and positive In return we offer excellent training and career opportunities, mentorship and guidance throughout your traineeship and the opportunity to work with prominent international clients. You will be given challenging work and receive continuous feedback throughout each rotation. **What We Offer** Your benefits as a Trainee Solicitor: * Competitive salary * Full pay during PPC course and fees fully covered * Supportive environment and open culture * Prominent international clients and challenging work * Working directly with associates and partners * Tailored learning & development programme * Opportunities for client secondments * Annual leave of 20 days * Private healthcare cover * Pension scheme * Life cover * Income protection * Education bursary (discretionary) * Employee assistance programme * ‘Dress for your Day’ dress code * Annual & monthly tax saver travel scheme * Bike to work scheme * Bank at work * Wellness programme including annual health screening, dedicated Wellness month and onsite wellness room * Annual health screening * Free flu vaccination annually * VDU eye testing and contribution towards eyesight testing and glasses/contact lenses * Regular social events such as summer BBQ, Christmas party and dedicated trainee events * Opportunities to participate in a range of CSR initiatives * Active Diversity & Inclusion Committee * Onsite gym * Onsite changing facilities and shower room with towel service and secure bike storage * Access to agile working * Central location in the IFSC * Complimentary breakfast items, fresh fruit and snacks **Life at Walkers** At Walkers, we have a dedicated social committee which includes members from across the office, including a trainee representative, who get involved in organising and hosting a variety of social events throughout the year. The committee organizes a variety of social events during the year such as our Summer BBQ, Christmas party, hikes and pizza evenings. There are numerous opportunities for us all to get together and for you to get to know your fellow trainees and colleagues, outside of the office. Along with firm wide events, there are regular department get togethers and dedicated trainee social events during the year.
